title: The Phone You Own, Not the Phone That Owns You
caption:
Notice who reaches first when it gets quiet.

Silence hits and your hand moves before your mind does. That reflex is the actual owner talking. Boredom isn't an emergency. You don't need rescuing from a slow line or a quiet elevator.

Give the Word the same attention you already give the feed. A free man can put his phone down, not delete it, not perform a detox. Just prove today it doesn't own the first five minutes of your morning.

#faith #discipline #godlyman #christianmen #phonefree
